Darrell, there's no change yet, and I'm sorry. Your Thor P2 (Shop····) is still set aside for you at our Tennessee warehouse. It can't ship until the warehouse checks your NerdOctaxe in, and that still hasn't happened, even though UPS delivered it to the dock on November 6.

Six days is too long, so I've raised it with the team again. They're back tomorrow at 10am ET and their reply will go to (email hidden) You don't have to do anything else. You'll get the Thor P2 tracking by email as soon as it ships.
